summary: Frontend testing of BOM Page multi-level explosion tree view and Job Work Bulk SC with job_work_parts pricing. All features verified working correctly.

issues: Minor: Console warning about Select component switching between controlled/uncontrolled state when using status filter
Minor: Console warning about missing Description for DialogContent (accessibility)

BOM Page: Color-coded badges working - FG (2), SG (3), RM (5), CP (4) badges found
BOM Page: Dark blue header bars (bg-[#1D3557]) for FG/SG parent items
BOM Page: Expand/collapse chevron buttons working on sub-assembly rows (SA-001 Pump Assembly)
BOM Page: Action buttons (View/Edit/Revise/Delete) present on BOM header rows
BOM Page: View dialog opens showing BOM Explosion with total cost (₹349.00)
BOM Page: Status filter (All/Draft/Active/Obsolete) works correctly
BOM Page: Total cost displayed correctly in header (₹349.00 and ₹3,528.00)
BOM Page: Collapsing sub-assembly hides children rows (toggle button works)
BOM Page: Row colors by category - SG (brown border), RM (blue border), CP (red border)
Job Work Page: Page loads with KPIs (Active Orders, Materials Sent, Materials Received, Processing Charges)
Job Work Page: Tabs working (Subcontract Orders, Delivery Challans, Receipts)
Job Work Page: Create Order dialog has Job Work Parts (FG/SA/Parts) section with Charges/pc column
Job Work Page: Create Order dialog has Raw Materials to Send section
Job Work Page: SC order created with job_work_parts showing per-part charges (@₹50.00)
Job Work Page: Charges calculated correctly (10 x ₹50 = ₹500.00)
Job Work Page: Order status flow working (draft → confirmed → in_progress)
Job Work Page: Send DC dialog shows RM items with stock info
Job Work Page: DC created successfully with RM Price column (₹900.00)
Job Work Page: Print DC button available on challans
Job Work Page: DC print opens new window with print preview

BOM Page: flattenRows function recursively builds explosion table with proper level indentation
Job Work Page: job_work_parts array properly stores per-part charges and calculates totals

bom_explosion_tree.details: Multi-level BOM explosion renders directly on main page with color-coded rows. 2 BOM groups found (SA-001 Pump Assembly, FG-001 Hydraulic Press 50T). Badges: FG (dark blue), SG (brown), RM (blue), CP (red).

bom_expand_collapse.details: Chevron toggle buttons work on sub-assembly rows. expandedItems state defaults to expanded. Clicking collapses/expands children.

bom_action_buttons.details: View (Eye), Edit (Pencil), Revise (GitBranch), Delete (Trash) buttons present on header rows. View opens dialog with explosion data.

bom_status_filter.details: Filter dropdown with All Statuses, Draft, Active, Obsolete options. Clear button removes filter.

bom_total_cost.details: Total cost displayed in header bar for each BOM (₹349.00, ₹3,528.00). Also shown in View dialog.

jobwork_bulk_sc.details: Create Order dialog has Job Work Parts section with Part, Qty, Charges/pc, Total columns. Per-part charges displayed as @₹50.00 in order table.

jobwork_dc_print.details: DC print opens new window with Job Work Part Details and Raw Material Issued sections. RM Price column shows calculated cost (₹900.00).
